correctness.rationale: For h>0,k>=0 the cubic Routh–Hurwitz coefficients and determinant D=2h²+h+2k²+8k+8 are strictly positive, giving unique stationary covariance solving M S+S M^T=-2I. With Q=M S+I antisymmetric the conventional stationary overdamped EPR is tr(S^{-1}Q^TQ); exact symbolic covariance elimination yields the stated rational function. Independent symbolic differentiation verified derivative 4(h²-h+k+2)(2(h-1)k+2h-5)/D², hence damping monotonic trichotomy h<=1, 1<h<5/2, h>=5/2 and k* formula. Baseline subtraction factors with F(h)=2h³-4h²+8h-9, unique positive h_c, and k_eq. Independent stationary covariance solves at four rational sample values plus exact symbolic factor checks; the two-copy embedding is orthogonal Laplacian mode decomposition. The proof is an exact rational identity plus signs, not numerical extrapolation.
